commentary.commentary: 13th over, dot and a big wicket — chase wobbling, win probability now 33.8% with the asking rate climbing.
That boundary in over 15 — a 4, closing in on the target; win probability up to 66%.
Smashed for 6 in the 16th — closing in on the target, win probability jumps to 71%.
Dot and a wicket at 16 — after wickets became scarce, chase collapses; win probability falls to 41%.
Eighteenth over, hammered for six — closing in on the target, win probability climbs to 61%.
18th over, massive six takes the score to 149 — closing in on the target, win probability 77%.
Big breakthrough in the 18th — 149/7, 18 off 12, win drops to 59.6% after wickets became scarce.
Massive six! In over 20, chase swings — win probability now 50% with 2 balls remaining.
Soft single keeps the chase alive — win probability now 33.8% with 1 ball remaining, 2 needed.
Final ball gone for 2, win probability rockets to 99%, with the asking rate in reach
